issues.issue: Is the claimant's account of a threatening note under his door credible?
issues.applicant_position: A threatening note was slid under his door after a kidnapper threatened him; he threw it away out of fear.
issues.result_text: On balance there was no note; the account is a fabrication to bolster the refugee claim, undermining credibility.

issues.issue: Did the claimant rebut the presumption of state protection in Mexico?
issues.applicant_position: Police are corrupt and loyal to drug traffickers; the Human Rights Commission is ineffective, so he did not approach authorities.
issues.result_text: Claimant did not rebut the presumption with clear and convincing evidence or exhaust state protection; Mexico is a functioning democracy.
